title: Anomaly.Quests.Names
description: Snapshot (1.2.0): the realm's own name for each quest, keyed by its quest flag (the ability `giveability <flag> <value>` advances) and the range of flag values the name covers. A client shows these names where it would otherwise fall back to a generic label for a flag it does not know ("Ability 3200"). Sent when the client subscribes to the Anomaly.Quests module and again after the server reloads its game data; it does not change during a session otherwise. Entries are ordered by flag, then from. A flag with several quests over its values (the alignment flags, the campaign) has one entry per range; ranges of one flag do not overlap.

flag.description: the quest flag: an ability code, the same number in the game and in the MDB (ability codes are not renumbered)

from.description: the lowest flag value the name covers; a client step (the value a stage starts at) inside [from, to] takes this name

to.description: the highest flag value the name covers; null = every value from `from` up

name.description: the quest's name as the realm's quest list and Quest Book give it, without the giver or place

level.description: the lowest level the quest takes, when the realm's quest list gives one; null when it does not
